narrative:
## Handover Summary — ALM & Repricing Gap

The hedge programme is approved and the net 0-3M gap is inside the ALCO limit.

## Key Decisions
- +PLN 300M 3Y receive-fixed IRS on the 0-3M bucket
- PLN 180M forward-starting swap covering ex-Citi term deposit roll-off

## Recommendation for NIM Consolidation
The CFO should consolidate hedge carry into the NII bridge and confirm NIM stays above 3.80% under the dovish path.

## Risk Factors
- ΔEVE sensitivity rising as swap duration extends
- Hedge-accounting effectiveness on deposit hedges

signals.title: EBA IRRBB Supervisory Outlier Test
signals.excerpt: Banks must report ΔNII and ΔEVE under prescribed rate shocks; a ΔEVE decline above 15% of Tier 1 capital triggers supervisory dialogue.
